credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe dressed in a sweater and a white apron, sitting on a cushion and holding her bent legs to her chest while picking up a watercolor brush with her other hand.  She looks slightly away from the camera. At her side is an open box of watercolors, pad of paper and a dirty glass of water.  In the background is foliage and a corner foundation with lattice work and a drain.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
